en.headline: Major regional sports law body to establish Hong Kong headquarters by year end
en.dek: Deputy Secretary for Justice Horace Cheung said a major regional sports law organisation will set up its base in the city within this year.
body: Deputy Secretary for Justice Horace Cheung said on Saturday that the headquarters of a major regional sports law organisation will be established in Hong Kong by the end of the year.
Cheung said the government is actively drawing international sports bodies to set up a presence in the city as part of efforts to promote Hong Kong as a centre for sports-related services.
He provided no further details about the organisation, saying the government would announce them in due course.
A lawmaker has suggested that more regional or international sports associations may relocate their bases to Hong Kong as part of a continuing trend.

zh.headline: 主要區域體育法律機構將於年底前在港設立總部
zh.dek: 律政司副司長張國鈞表示，一個主要區域體育法律機構將於今年內在香港設立總部。
body: 律政司副司長張國鈞周六表示，一個主要區域體育法律機構將於今年年底前在香港設立總部。
張國鈞指，政府正積極吸引國際體育機構來港設立據點，以推動香港成為體育相關服務中心。
他未有進一步透露機構詳情，表示政府將適時公布。
有立法會議員暗示，更多區域或國際體育協會可能會將基地遷至香港，作為持續趨勢的一部分。
